_meta.name: xp research evaluation set
_meta.purpose: Repeatable regression harness for the research pipeline: search -> permitted fetch -> extraction -> provenance classification -> cross-source comparison -> cited report. All pages are offline fixtures (.test TLD); no network is touched.
quality_bars: every claim in the generated report is cited
conflicts between sources are detected and disclosed
unavailable sources and coverage gaps are disclosed
listing-snapshot prices are typed 'estimate', never presented as live
the rendered PDF passes structural validation
